name: std::basic_string_view<CharT,Traits>::operator[]
intro:
Returns a const reference to the character at specified location pos.

No bounds checking is performed: the behavior is undefined if pos >= size().

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
pos

 -

 position of the character to return

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Const reference to the requested character.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: Unlike std::basic_string::operator[], std::basic_string_view::operator[](size()) has undefined behavior instead of returning CharT().

summary: Returns a const reference to the character at specified location pos.
